CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 3, 2022

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: PC Meeting – January 3, 2022 (Audio).m4a /
  PC Meeting – January 3, 2022 (Video).m4a

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Mojarro arrived at 7:05 P.M.

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Werner
  Abrego, Assistant Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – DECEMBER 6, 2021 (7:02 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the December 6, 2021, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the December 6, 2021, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Garcia
  Absent: Mojarro

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

  1
  01/03/2022
 F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-21-20 (7:03 P.M.)
  • 19 South Garfield Avenue, Units A & B
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow
  an on-premise alcoholic beverage license (Type 41) for the sale of
  beer and wine in conjunction with meal service in an existing
  restaurant, Borneo Kalimantan Cuisine, located in the CBD-DRD
  (Central Business District-Downtown Revitalization District) zone.
  (This item is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-01, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-21-20, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Assistant Planner Werner Abrego provided the Staff presentation.
  • Liliger Damaso, Ron Ancheta, and Peter Then, the Applicants,
  were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) John Bwarie (Alhambra Chamber of Commerce)

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-21-24 (7:18 P.M.)
  • 560 West Main Street, Unit A
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow
  an on-premise alcoholic beverage license (Type 41) for the sale of
  beer and wine in conjunction with meal service in an existing
  restaurant, BBQ Chicken Alhambra, located in the CPD (Commercial
  Planned Development) zone. (This item is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-02, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-21-24, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Assistant Planner Werner Abrego provided the Staff presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened then closed.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  2
  01/03/2022
   Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT GPA-22-01 (7:26 P.M.)
  • Citywide
  • Request: This is a Public Hearing for General Plan Amendment
  GPA-22-01 for the Draft 2021-2029 Housing Element of the
  Alhambra General Plan and Negative Declaration, and the
  forwarding of a recommendation to the Alhambra City Council to
  submit the Draft Housing Element to the State Department of
  Housing and Community Development.
  • Recommended  Action:  Adopt  Resolution  No.  22-03,
  recommending that the City Council adopt a Resolution approving
  the Negative Declaration, approve the 2021-2029 Alhambra Housing
  Element, and direct staff to submit the 2021-2029 Housing Element
  to the State Department of Housing and Community Development for
  certification.
  • Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso provided the Staff presentation.
  • The City’s consultant, ECONorthwest, provided the presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Ted Jimenez (Southwest Regional Council of Carpenters)
  3.) John Bwarie (Alhambra Chamber of Commerce)
  4.) Jim Gallagher
  5.) Mandy Huffman (LA County Sanitation District)
  6.) Henry Fung

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to recommend City Council approve Agenda Item 4 with
  modification to Program 31 as stated by the City’s consultant,
  ECONorthwest.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

G.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso reported on the proposed SB-9 ordinance. The
  City has been considering adopting a local ordinance in response to the State law
  3
  01/03/2022
   requirements regarding urban lot splits that are affective January 1. The Council will
  be considering a City ordinance tomorrow at 9:00 A.M. to adopt City regulations for
  SB-9 in Alhambra. The second community outreach meeting regarding the Historic
  Preservation Program is scheduled for January 26th at 6:00 P.M. This meeting will
  focus on the recently released Historic Context Statement draft which is on the project
  website. The draft document is available for review and public comment until
  February 28th. (10:00 P.M.)

H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

I.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  •  Commissioner Wang inquired if there was an extremely low-income category for the
  Inclusionary Housing Ordinance. She would like to look further into it, including studies
  of neighboring cities, to examine the effectiveness of the Inclusionary Housing
  Ordinance. (10:04 P.M.)
  •  Commissioner Sahu inquired if Council is looking at the Inclusionary Housing
  Ordinance in-lieu fee. (10:07 P.M.)
  •  President Gardea shared his support for revisiting the effectiveness of the
  Inclusionary Housing Ordinance (10:07 P.M.)
  •  Commissioner Ho highlighted that the in-lieu fees go toward developing affordable
  housing projects. (10:08 P.M.)

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 10:12 P.M. to Monday,
  January 18, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.

  _______________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
